info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Cloud Build API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Build triggers and private worker pools are configuration metadata: no build runs, no webhook, Pub/Sub or repository event is received, no source repository is contacted and no worker VM is provisioned; worker pools report RUNNING immediately. A trigger's ID equals its name, so the resource name, id and name address the same trigger. The legacy projectId and triggerId query parameters are not consulted; the resource name decides. Secret Manager references are stored as names and never resolved; inline KMS-encrypted secrets (build.secrets, build.availableSecrets.inline) are refused. Cloud Build v2 connections are not served.
info.title: Cloud Build (simulator catalog)
